audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3, First item and 2+ items all read Zaahen in both layers; the packet chart says Skill, Zac, Zac.
audit.why: The content whys for those exact rows already read 'Level 3 evens out', 'First item favours Zac' and 'keep him well ahead' — three tokens contradicting their own explanations, on a matchup where the late game genuinely belongs to a tank.
audit.corrected: win[2]/phases[2].side -> Skill, win[5]/phases[5].side -> Zac, win[6]/phases[6].side -> Zac, one atomic group, with ratings dropped to 4/10 and 3/10 on the two Zac-sided rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere: Elastic Slingshot, Stretching Strikes and Let's Bounce! were all named without a timer, and the level-2 window was asserted without saying what makes it safe.
audit.why: Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s and Stretching Strikes is 14/12.5/11/9.5/8s — at rank 1 both are enormous, which is exactly why levels 2-3 are yours.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Elastic Slingshot carries the grounding flag — it shuts off dashes — and this appeared nowhere on the page, even though Zaahen's E is a dash and the page's whole escape plan depends on it. Zaahen's R was also used as peel and as a dive-cancel in four fields; it has no CC.
audit.why: Getting grounded means the dash you were saving does not exist, so the exit has to be planned on foot. And spending a 110-second R expecting an interrupt loses both the fight and the cooldown.
audit.corrected: spikes[1], spikes[3], late, whys[4], dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d now state the grounding and the R's real behaviour.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Fight without anti-heal' had placeholder text, and armour was the implied answer to a tank.
audit.why: Cell Division heals him off shed chunks and revives him from bloblets, and Unstable Matter is percent maximum health — both flagged in missingInteractions as needs-antiheal and resistances-invalidated.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[2].d and dosFull[1].d rewritten around denying blobs and buying Grievous Wounds instead of armour.

edits.before: Level 6 is even — his R roam threat is offset by your R Final Retribution peel.
edits.after: Level 6 is even — his R roam threat is offset by your R's damage and heal.

edits.before: Zac is a weak laner early — his Q (Stretching Strike) is his only real trade and his passive blobs are the only sustain he has. Punish him at level 2 when you have Q Darkin Glaive plus E Golden Onslaught: engage before his blobs drop, deny the pickups, and force him to base low. Don't let him free-farm and heal off blobs.
edits.after: Zac is a weak laner early — Stretching Strikes (Q, 14s at rank 1) is his only real trade and his passive blobs are the only sustain he has. Punish him at level 2 while that Q is down: engage before the blobs land, step on them to deny the pickups, and force him to base low. Never let him free-farm and heal.

edits.before: Zac's R (Let's Bounce) and long-range E (Elastic Slingshot) turn him into a roam/pick threat at 6, so trades stay even as he plays for jungle collapses and cross-map dives. Ward his flanks and hold R Final Retribution to peel his knock-up bounce rather than spending it offensively.
edits.after: Let's Bounce! (R) and Elastic Slingshot (E, 21s at rank 1) turn him into a roam and pick threat at 6, so trades stay even while he plays for jungle collapses. Ward his flanks, and spend your R for its damage and heal inside the fight — it carries no CC, so it cannot peel his bounce.

edits.before: Two items in Zac is a full tank engage-machine: his E flies across screens and R chain-knocks your carries. Your telegraphed E does little to him. Play as a peel/anti-engage juggernaut, holding R Final Retribution to cancel his dives, not to duel.
edits.after: Two items in Zac is a full tank engage-machine: his E flies across screens and R chain-knocks your carries. His W is percent maximum health, so armour will not save you. Your R heals off the damage it deals but interrupts nothing — spend it in the fight, not on his dive.

edits.before: Once Zac has tank items his blob sustain, W %-HP damage and E-R engage out-scale you completely; you can't solo him. Shift into a peel role — hold R Final Retribution to cancel his dives onto your carries, match his roams, and win through your team rather than a duel.
edits.after: Once Zac has tank items his blob sustain, W percent-health damage and E-R engage out-scale you completely; you can't solo him. Grievous Wounds is the answer here, not armour — his W ignores it. Match his roams, deny every blob, and win through your team rather than a duel.

edits.before: His engage. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1. Step in once it is spent.

edits.before: Probe Zac's pattern early, then commit your full combo only on his key cooldown — bank knowledge before blood.
edits.after: Every ability he lands sheds a chunk he can reabsorb — walk over them and half his sustain never happens.

edits.before: Zac wastes Elastic Slingshot — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: His E grounds you where it lands — your dash is gone until it ends.

edits.before: That is Zac's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Blobs are his only real lane sustain — deny them and he recalls first.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His E grounds on landing, so plan the exit on foot, not on a dash.

edits.before: Coin-flipping into an unknown matchup — respect what you have not seen until you have seen it twice.
edits.after: His W is percent maximum health and he revives off bloblets — armour is not the answer, Grievous Wounds is.

edits.before: - Zac Elastic Slingshot: matchup-defining — His engage. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Zac Elastic Slingshot: 21s at rank 1 — it grounds you where it lands, so your dash is gone. - Stretching Strikes: 14s at rank 1, an auto reset. - Unstable Matter: 5s, percent maximum health. - Your R: kill windows only.

notes: Elastic Slingshot's grounding flag was absent from the entire page even though it turns off Zaahen's only dash — that is the single most useful thing on this matchup and it is now in three fields. Zaahen's R was used as peel or a dive-cancel in four places; it has no CC. The packet's two suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES in spirit but real typos in fact: the page wrote 'Stretching Strike' (real name Stretching Strikes) and 'Let's Bounce' (real name Let's Bounce!); both corrected. Chart rows 2, 5 and 6 realigned to the packet, backed by the whys already on the page.
